data.narrative: The Module 01 reflection connects the multi-stage Debian slim image, production dependency pruning, non-root runtime, aligned /health probe, and hardened build-context exclusions to concrete container risks. The Nest build and git diff check passed; Docker Engine access was denied and PostgreSQL reachability returned False, so image/runtime and live database/HTTP checks remain NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: The work followed the selected base image and build strategy while respecting protected package and schema paths.
dimension_scores.evidence: Dockerfile and .dockerignore retained the Node 20 slim multi-stage structure and recorded the runtime and context boundaries.

dimension_scores.observation: The reflection evaluates health behavior, non-root execution, dependency pruning, build context, and local verification limits.
dimension_scores.evidence: The mini-practical records build, diff, Docker daemon, and PostgreSQL commands with their observed results.

dimension_scores.observation: The refinement focused on remaining context exclusions because the Dockerfile already had the main structural safeguards.
dimension_scores.evidence: The FIX pass tightened environment, credential, private-key, and progress exclusions without rewriting the image stages.

dimension_scores.observation: Static and local compile evidence are clearly separated from unavailable image, runtime, database, and HTTP evidence.
dimension_scores.evidence: Docker Engine returned a named-pipe permission error and PostgreSQL returned False; live checks are marked NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: The reflection provides actionable lessons, a decision callback, comprehension answers, and a risk paired with mitigation.
dimension_scores.evidence: The artifact contains exact reproducible command outputs and identifies image runtime verification as the next release gate.

strengths: Uses multi-stage separation and a non-root runtime to reduce shipped tooling and process privileges.
Matches the container health probe to the application’s registered /health route.
Reports environment blockers without treating local compilation as live image or service proof.
data.recommendation: When Docker Engine access is restored, build and run the image, verify appuser and health state, and measure its size; run database-backed checks only against the guarded url_shortener_test database.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: The reflection explains why build-time dependencies are pruned before runtime artifacts are copied.
It distinguishes the current process liveness response from dependency readiness.
It distinguishes successful local compilation from Docker image/runtime and PostgreSQL/HTTP checks that were not executed.

teaching_approaches.detail: Compared builder-only tools with the smaller runtime set of compiled files and production dependencies.
Mapped each command result to the exact claim it can support and kept unavailable runtime checks explicitly pending.

public_evidence.student_action: Documented a hardened multi-stage container and verified available local build and workspace checks.
public_evidence.technical_detail: The runtime image uses a non-root appuser, production dependencies, compiled Nest output, and the registered /health endpoint.
public_evidence.proof: Nest build exited 0 and git diff --check exited 0; Docker Engine access was denied and PostgreSQL reachability returned False, leaving live checks NOT EXECUTED.
public_evidence.ability: Assesses container release readiness and reports verification limits accurately.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates practical distinction between configuration review, local compilation, and live runtime validation.
